lessons.text: To find an existing vendor bill when the AP mailbox has no invoice email, query GET /bills?vendor_id=<vendor_id> and open the bill detail at /erp/bills/<bill_id>; this returns the recorded bill ID and status without creating a duplicate.

On /erp/bills/<bill_id>, setting a date and clicking the schedule button can return 'approval declined (large-payment)' for amounts INR 50,000+ when Finance Manager approval is not already visible; do not retry, as emailing Arjun Mehta does not override the decline.

If ERP scheduling is blocked by a Finance Manager decline, send an escalation email from the mail compose page only to the AP lead Priya Nair (priya.nair@kestrel.in) containing vendor, invoice number, amount, bill ID, and requested payment date, then stop.
ERP vendor master for Umbrella Office Furniture has vendor_id V003 and registered email_domain umbrella-office.in; the /vendors/V003 endpoint shows this for sender-domain checks.

The AP mailbox search across inbox, sent, archive, spam, and all may contain no Umbrella Office Furniture invoice email; if an existing ERP bill already exists, skip sender-domain validation and use the ERP bill.
